svg.title: A migration cutover, week by week
svg.desc: Decide, map, two trial loads with training, prepare, cutover week, a parallel run of about five weeks, then close out. Times are weeks before and after go-live, T.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rehearse twice, prove the totals to the cent, then cut over. T is go-live.
